The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the context of a national antiretrovial therapy (ART) scale-up programme, the mortality rate of HIV-1-infected individuals receiving ART in Senegal is high and is mainly related to opportunistic infections, especially mycobacterial infections.
, in the absence of effective TB screening, the introduction of HAART in settings with a high prevalence of TB is likely to result in an increase in the number of TB-related deaths.
